summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Coventry, with a 1.8 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD298C INSTALLED WI 1.8NM RADIUS OF
522429N 0013037W (COVENTRY). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS)
UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG 
SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL 
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT 
(VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR 
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR 
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO 
AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-2281/07.
